purpose: Protected behavioral acceptance for lossless, bounded community-fact drain recovery

seam.runtime: Actual DeferredCommunityFacts::drain and actual queue state, not a reimplementation
seam.double: Task-local record_fact boundary returns true, false, a typed store error, or a pending future; captures complete attempted/acknowledged FactWrite payloads
seam.baselineExecution: Run-owned scratch snapshot changes only the external record_fact import and cfg(test) child-module registration; no drain/capture/classification/state implementation changes
seam.builderRegistration: Register community_facts_requeue_acceptance at ../tests/support/community_facts_requeue.rs with cfg(test). Bind its record_fact under cfg(test), and two_bot_core::community_store::record_fact under cfg(not(test)); see runner.BINDING/REGISTRATION. Existing tests outside the task-local scope delegate to the real store.
seam.ciRoute: Builder must retain the module registration and test-only binding so the existing db-feature library CI/nextest lanes execute the protected corpus, rather than leaving an orphan support file
seam.database: Lazy passwordless test pool only; scoped test store never opens a connection. No database environment, database creation, HTTP or Discord required. Compilation always uses scripts/cargo_cache.py on the controller.

contract.storeErrors: Fail at every one of the seven write positions: preserve failed and unattempted payloads across pending/rules/joins; consume only acknowledged prefix
contract.timeout: Caller drops the real drain future through Tokio timeout at first write and mid-pending, mid-rules and mid-joins; retain exactly the unacknowledged suffix
contract.duplicates: Ok(false) acknowledges a duplicate/privacy-suppressed write without counting it inserted; never resubmit it after a later error or timeout
contract.noPool: Repeated no-pool drains return zero with all previously queued payloads unchanged; arming later drains those facts exactly once
contract.concurrency: Arrivals captured while the taken batch is being written survive error/cancellation; prepend the unwritten old batch ahead of arrivals within each family
contract.bounds: Mirror the game-activity precedent: per-family cap 8192, evict oldest overflow, no cross-family capacity borrowing, no eviction at exactly the cap
contract.observableDrops: Expose dropped_counts() -> Result<(u64, u64, u64), CommunityFactsError> in (pending, rules, joins) order. Count exact cumulative evictions; successful/empty drains never reset counts. The baseline adapter returns truthful zero; it implements no recovery and an inherent runtime method overrides it.
contract.poison: Typed CommunityFactsError::Poisoned before store work or any family take; poison remains latched and every payload stays untrusted and queued
contract.controls: Successful all-family drain, duplicate acknowledgement/count, and typed poison preservation

handoff: Do not merge acceptance-only RED tests. Builder consumes the immutable pushed SHA and preserves every protected file hash, registering the child module and test binding in production source.
Expected baseline result: 22 assertion failures for discarded queues and 3 passing controls. This is not an observed result; actual execution evidence belongs in the task handoff document.
Cache admission refusal (exit 75) is neither a compilation result nor acceptance RED. Never bypass the wrapper, create another target cache, clear sentinels or evict shared caches.
Builder owns runtime GREEN, ordinary exact-head CI plus independent Paperclip Review 5/5, verified squash auto-merge and combined PR delivery. Oracle corrections return to the Test Author.
